extraction_text: Bhishma describes the warriors and armies allied with the Pandavas.

attributes.context: Bhishma is speaking to King Dhritarashtra about the upcoming Kurukshetra War.

extraction_text: Bhishma identifies Draupadi's five sons, Uttara (son of Virata), Abhimanyu, Satyaki, Uttamaujas, and Yudhamanyu as great warriors.

attributes.relationships: Draupadi's sons are sons of the Pandavas. Uttara is son of King Virata. Abhimanyu is son of Arjuna and Subhadra. Satyaki is a Yadava warrior and ally of Krishna. Uttamaujas and Yudhamanyu are Panchala warriors.
attributes.military_assessment: Bhishma praises their bravery and skill, noting they will fight to please Yudhishthira.

extraction_text: Bhishma states that Kings Virata and Drupada are invincible veteran warriors allied with the Pandavas.

attributes.relationships: Virata and Drupada are fathers-in-law to the Pandavas (through marriage of Arjuna to Subhadra? Actually, Virata's daughter Uttara married Abhimanyu, and Drupada's daughter Draupadi married all five Pandavas). They are loyal allies bound by marriage and dharma.
attributes.military_assessment: They will lead large armies and fight fiercely to support the Pandavas.

extraction_text: Bhishma identifies Shikhandin as a chief warrior for the Pandavas.

attributes.relationships: Shikhandin is the prince of Panchala, son of Drupada, and brother of Draupadi.
attributes.military_assessment: He will lead a large army of Panchalas and Prabhadrakas and win high honor in battle.

extraction_text: Bhishma identifies Dhrishtadyumna as a great warrior and supreme commander of the Pandava army.

attributes.relationships: Dhrishtadyumna is son of Drupada, brother of Draupadi, and student of Drona.
attributes.military_assessment: He will fight like the god Shiva, with a vast army like the gods'.

extraction_text: Bhishma assesses other warriors: Shatrunjaya (young son of Dhrishtadyumna) as a half-warrior, and Shishupala's son (king of Chedi) as a great warrior allied with the Pandavas.

attributes.relationships: Shatrunjaya is Dhrishtadyumna's son. The King of Chedi is related by marriage to the Pandavas.
attributes.military_assessment: Shatrunjaya is inexperienced; the King of Chedi is a great warrior.
